props.text: Free, open-source e-commerce you host yourself
Modrix Commerce is an online store platform built on Laravel. Install it on your own hosting, keep your orders and customer data, and add themes and modules when you need them.

What you get
Run your own store
Install Modrix Commerce on your own hosting. Your products, orders and customers stay in your own database.
Add what you need
Start with the core, then add themes and modules such as payment providers, reviews, newsletters or flash sales.
Manage it from one admin
Handle orders, pages and settings in one place. Staff roles, an audit log and scheduled backups are included.
Good places to start
Themes and modules
Install free themes and modules from Admin → Extensions, or upload a ZIP file. Each one can be updated or rolled back from the same screen.
Try the Vertex demo
Import the header, the footer and six example pages, then edit them in the page builder.
Payments are added as modules
Payment providers such as PayPal and Razorpay are available as modules, so you only add the ones you use.
